purpose: Defines the dimensionless Fourier number α (diffusion parameter) from the diffusion coefficient D, solidification time t_f, and secondary dendrite arm spacing λ; α is then used in Eq. (9) to compute the inverse diffusion coefficient Ω.

symbols.meaning: Fourier number (dimensionless diffusion parameter) defined by Eq. (10), used to calculate the inverse diffusion coefficient Ω in Eq. (9)
solidification time (local solidification time), expressed by Eq. (11)
distance between the secondary dendrite arms (secondary dendrite arm spacing)

unmapped: The values of k and D are shown in Table 5 (refs. [42-44]).
The factor 0.5 in (0.5λ)^2 corresponds to λ/2, i.e., half the secondary dendrite arm spacing (the characteristic diffusion length); the paper does not explicitly define this factor.
t_f is expressed by Eq. (11): t_f = (T_L − T_s)/R_C.
